title: Optimal selection of reduced rank estimators of high-dimensional matrices
one_line_what_it_does: RSC rank selection, consistent for rank of coefficient matrix; iid noise, fixed design; PDF keyword-scanned (no group/cluster/fixed-effect/nuisance hits)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 1 and 2 (the rule that is shown to over-select / be consistent); any pooled-vs-within result is a corollary of its consistency theorem applied to an enlarged or projected coefficient

title: Adaptive estimation of the rank of the coefficient matrix in high dimensional multivariate response regression models
one_line_what_it_does: Self-tuning iterative rank estimator, finite-sample rank consistency for any m,p,n; iid noise; PDF keyword-scanned (no cluster/fixed-effect/nuisance hits)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 1 and 2 (Bing-Wegkamp rule named in claim)

title: Adaptive estimation in multivariate response regression with hidden variables
one_line_what_it_does: Y=Psi'X+B'Z+E with unobserved Z correlated with X; best linear predictor coefficient F=Psi+A B is identifiable and equals sparse plus dense rank-K matrix; estimates K and row space of B; random design, no groups
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 1 mechanism (pervasive hidden factor absorbed into pooled coefficient so its rank inflates by K); not stated as a rank-selection theorem and no p>=G-1 group design

title: Simultaneous heterogeneity and reduced-rank learning for multivariate response regression
one_line_what_it_does: Y_i=a_i+B'x_i+e with subgroup-specific intercept vectors a_i and rank(B)=r*; oracle rank-constrained estimator with known subgroup indicators (=within estimator) with oracle inequality; rank selected by penalised criterion; unknown subgroups estimated by fusion penalty
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 2 (reduced-rank estimation/selection after absorbing group-level intercepts); no pooled over-selection, no CV, no between rank, no p>=G-1 regime

title: On cross-validation for sparse reduced rank regression
venue_or_arxiv: J. R. Stat. Soc. B 81(1) / arXiv:1812.11555
one_line_what_it_does: Shows CV with fixed tuning across folds can be inconsistent for sparse+low-rank RRR; proposes structural CV and scale-free criteria; iid rows
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 4 context (CV for rank selection known to misbehave in iid case); no group CV

title: Regression approaches for modelling genotype-environment interaction and making predictions into unseen environments
one_line_what_it_does: Reduced-rank regression/factor-analytic models for genotype x environment with environmental covariates; leave-one-environment-out CV for prediction; no rank-selection theory
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 2 and 4 context (environment-level shifts, LOEO CV, RRR in plant breeding)

title: Model selection and cross validation in additive main effect and multiplicative interaction models
one_line_what_it_does: AMMI: remove additive environment/genotype main effects then choose number of multiplicative axes by leave-one-out CV vs F-tests
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 2 and 4 context (within-group rank after removing group main effects is classical practice in agronomy; CV for axis count)

title: Randomization tests under an approximate symmetry assumption
one_line_what_it_does: Sign-change randomization tests with fixed small number of clusters; asymptotically valid under approximate symmetry
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 3 machinery (group-level sign flips with few groups)

title: On the implementation of approximate randomization tests in linear models with a small number of clusters
one_line_what_it_does: User guide: group of sign changes has cardinality 2^q for q clusters; valid with as few as five clusters
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 3 (2^G sign-change group, resolution limit of p-values with few groups)

title: Multi-level block permutation
one_line_what_it_does: Permutation and sign-flipping that respect hierarchical exchangeability blocks (whole-block flips)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 3 machinery (block-level sign flips)

title: Permutation inference for canonical correlation analysis
one_line_what_it_does: Exact-style permutation tests for the number of nonzero canonical correlations (= rank of cross-covariance) after nuisance residualisation; discusses restricted exchangeability blocks for repeated measures
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 3 (permutation/sign-flip test of the number of canonical correlations = rank, with block structure); no group-level between rank with G-1 bound

title: Cross-validation for correlated data
one_line_what_it_does: Criterion for when standard CV is biased under within-cluster correlation; bias-corrected CVc; affects model selection
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 4 context (CV bias with clustered data; not rank, not LOGO under-selection)

title: Fast leave-one-cluster-out cross-validation using clustered Network Information Criterion (NICc)
one_line_what_it_does: Approximates leave-one-cluster-out deviance for clustered GLM selection of model size
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 4 context (leave-one-cluster-out model-size selection; scalar regression)

title: Linear model selection by cross-validation
one_line_what_it_does: LOO-CV is inconsistent for linear model selection; need n_v/n -> 1
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 4 background (CV inconsistency theory for iid)

title: Linear regression for panel with unknown number of factors as interactive fixed effects
one_line_what_it_does: Regression with unknown number of interactive fixed effects; inference on beta robust to over-estimating factor number
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Application 3 / nuisance-factor-in-regression econometrics (large N,T; not rank of predictable part)

title: Latent factor analysis in short panels
one_line_what_it_does: Test for number of latent factors with fixed T and large N; includes spanning/rank tests against observed factors
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Application 3 (few periods, number of factors); different estimand (latent-factor count)

title: A reduced-rank panel data model with interactive fixed effects
one_line_what_it_does: Reduced-rank heterogeneous slopes plus interactive fixed effects; selection criteria for both dimensions
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 2 context (rank of slope heterogeneity selected jointly with nuisance IFE dimension); large N,T

title: Generalized reduced rank tests using the singular value decomposition
one_line_what_it_does: Rank tests for matrices in econometrics
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 3 context (rank testing in econometrics); not group-level

title: Rank estimation in reduced-rank regression
one_line_what_it_does: Asymptotic rank test requiring finite second moments, low-dimensional
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 2/3 background (classical rank testing)

title: Anchor regression: heterogeneous data meet causality
one_line_what_it_does: Uses anchor (environment/batch) variables to handle shifts in hidden confounders and Y; predictive robustness
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Group-level nuisance shifts in Y and X (conceptual neighbour); no rank selection

title: Multilevel simultaneous component analysis: a computational shortcut and software package
one_line_what_it_does: Separate between- and within-component numbers with model-selection heuristics for nested data
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Between/within rank decomposition in chemometrics/psychometrics (unsupervised)

title: Multilevel exploratory factor analysis: approaches to identifying number of factors
one_line_what_it_does: Fit indices recover within-level factors but extract fewer between-level factors when ICC/cluster count small
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 2/3 context (between-level rank hard with few clusters; simulation only)

title: svaseq: removing batch effects and other unwanted noise from sequencing data
authors: Leek (per memory; not shown in snippet)
one_line_what_it_does: Surrogate variable analysis; number of hidden factors by permutation parallel analysis
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Application 1 (estimating nuisance factor count in genomics); not rank of predictable part

title: Simple tests for reduced rank in multivariate regression
one_line_what_it_does: Reduced-rank tests and estimators; notes use of RRR for limited heterogeneity among groups in panel data
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: Prop 2/3 background (reduced-rank tests across groups, low-dimensional)
